title: isodon bulleyanus
intro: Isodon bulleyanus, commonly known as Himalayan isodon or Bulley's isodon, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine, where it is valued for its multiple health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help to relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Isodon bulleyanus include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating respiratory and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
